## Summary
- [ ] Describe the specification or implementation change.
- [ ] Preserve canonical NUN names and versioned system contracts.

- Contract/behavior changed:

## Documentation and UI
- [ ] README and affected UA/EN/RU variants are current.
- [ ] Future UI follows `docs/gui/GUI_DESIGN_STANDARD.md`.
- [ ] Concept mockups are labelled; no bootable OS or GUI claim without implementation.
- [ ] Architecture, ABI, boot, memory and target assumptions are sourced.

## Verification
- [ ] Documentation/schema checks and CI pass.
- [ ] Contract examples and version compatibility checked.
- [ ] Changed code meets 80% coverage where configured or exception documented.
- [ ] Build, linker map, emulator and hardware evidence are distinguished.
- [ ] No unsupported CPU/board claims.

## Review policy
- Branches: `feature/<ticket>-<slug>`, `fix/<slug>`, `docs/<slug>`.
- No direct commits to protected default/release branches.
- Merge requires two independent approvals and all required CI checks, enforced through branch protection.
- [ ] Two independent approvals.
- [ ] Required CI checks green.

- [ ] Два незалежні схвалення та успішний CI перед злиттям.
